dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen someone who looks very much like me?

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Hmm, this is a difficult question to answer.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: It's not that I'm lazy and don't observe the people who come and go, but...

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is the most prosperous city among the seven nations. There are just too many people who move to and from it every day — it's impossible to remember them all.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Xun
dialogues.text: I'll help you keep a lookout, but don't get your hopes too high...
